worktrees.agent.badPlacement.defaultMessage: The panes can't be placed like that in this layout.
worktrees.agent.badPlacement.description: An error: saving where the user put the agents' panes in a layout (dragging a pane to another cell) was given a layout or places Hive doesn't know.

worktrees.agent.chooseMove.defaultMessage: Choose where to move the agent.
worktrees.agent.chooseMove.description: An error: an agent was to be moved in the project's order, with no place given.

worktrees.agent.chooseTree.description: An error: a new agent was to work in an existing worktree, and none was chosen.

worktrees.agent.detached.defaultMessage: That worktree is not on a branch (detached HEAD).
worktrees.agent.detached.description: An error: the worktree chosen for a new agent has no branch checked out. detached HEAD is git's term.

worktrees.agent.enterName.description: An error: an agent's name was emptied.

worktrees.agent.gone.description: An error: the agent being changed was removed meanwhile.

worktrees.agent.nameTaken.defaultMessage: There is already an agent called "{name}".
worktrees.agent.nameTaken.description: An error: the project already has an agent with the name {name}.

worktrees.agent.noBase.defaultMessage: The project folder is not on a branch. Choose the branch to start from.
worktrees.agent.noBase.description: An error: a new agent's worktree needs a branch to start from, and the project folder has none checked out.

worktrees.agent.noGitForTree.defaultMessage: {problem}, so Hive can't make a worktree.
worktrees.agent.noGitForTree.description: An error: a new agent's worktree can't be made because git can't run ({problem} says why).

worktrees.agent.noGitToCheck.defaultMessage: {problem}, so Hive can't check that worktree.
worktrees.agent.noGitToCheck.description: An error: the worktree chosen for a new agent can't be checked because git can't run ({problem} says why).

worktrees.agent.noTree.defaultMessage: This agent works in the project folder, not a worktree.
worktrees.agent.noTree.description: An error: something only a worktree agent has (its branch's state, a merge) was asked of an agent working in the project folder.

worktrees.agent.notATree.defaultMessage: That folder is not a worktree of this project.
worktrees.agent.notATree.description: An error: the folder chosen for a new agent to work in isn't one of the project's git worktrees.

worktrees.agent.removing.defaultMessage: That worktree is already being removed or merged.
worktrees.agent.removing.description: An error: the worktree is being removed or merged by another action right now.

worktrees.agent.roleTooLong.defaultMessage: A role is at most {max} characters.
worktrees.agent.roleTooLong.description: An error: an agent's role (what it does, in a few words) is longer than it may be ({max}, a number).

worktrees.agent.sharedTree.defaultMessage: Another agent already works in that worktree.
worktrees.agent.sharedTree.description: An error: an agent was to be added in a worktree another agent of the project already works in.

worktrees.agent.stopForProvider.defaultMessage: Stop the agent before changing its provider.
worktrees.agent.stopForProvider.description: An error: an agent's provider (its coding-agent CLI) can't change while it runs.

worktrees.agent.stopToMerge.defaultMessage: Stop {agent} before merging and removing its worktree.
worktrees.agent.stopToMerge.description: An error: a merge that also removes the worktree needs the agent {agent} (its name) stopped first.

worktrees.agent.stopToRemove.defaultMessage: Stop the agent before removing it.
worktrees.agent.stopToRemove.description: An error: a running agent can't be removed.

worktrees.agent.treeRemoved.defaultMessage: That worktree is being removed, or was just removed.
worktrees.agent.treeRemoved.description: An error: the worktree a new agent was to work in is being removed, or was removed while it was being added.

worktrees.agent.treeShared.description: Why a removed agent's worktree was kept: another agent of the project works in it. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.agent.unknownProvider.description: An error: {provider} is not a coding-agent CLI this Hive knows (Claude Code, Codex…).

worktrees.badBranchName.defaultMessage: "{branch}" is not a valid branch name.
worktrees.badBranchName.description: An error: git doesn't take {branch} as a branch name.

worktrees.branchInWay.defaultMessage: Git can't make the branch {branch}: a branch {parent} is in the way. Choose another branch.
worktrees.branchInWay.description: An error: a new branch {branch} can't be made, because a branch {parent} exists and git can't have a branch inside another's name.

worktrees.cantCheck.description: An error: git couldn't count the branch {branch}'s unmerged commits or its worktree's uncommitted files; {why} says why.

worktrees.deleteBranch.description: An error: the branch {branch} could not be deleted, and git said nothing about why.

worktrees.gitFailed.description: Why git couldn't do something, when git said nothing itself. {command} is the git command ("git rev-parse"): keep it as it is.

worktrees.gitProblem.description: An error: git cannot run. {problem} says why (git is missing, or too old), without its full stop.

worktrees.listBranches.description: An error: git couldn't list the repository's branches; {why} is git's reason.

worktrees.merge.cantCheck.defaultMessage: Git couldn't check the worktree for uncommitted changes (git status failed in {folder}). Fix it, then merge again.
worktrees.merge.cantCheck.description: Why nothing was merged: git couldn't say what is uncommitted in the worktree's folder {folder}.

worktrees.merge.commitFailed.defaultMessage: Could not commit the agent's changes: {why}
worktrees.merge.commitFailed.description: Why nothing was merged: the worktree's uncommitted changes couldn't be committed first. {why} is git's message.

worktrees.merge.detached.defaultMessage: The project folder is not on a branch (detached HEAD). Check out the branch to merge into first.
worktrees.merge.detached.description: Why nothing was merged: the project folder has no branch checked out. detached HEAD is git's term.

worktrees.merge.notRemoved.defaultMessage: Merged, but the worktree was not removed
worktrees.merge.notRemoved.description: A notification's title: the agent's work was merged, but removing its worktree afterwards failed (the reason follows).

worktrees.merge.nothing.description: Why nothing was merged: git couldn't read the project folder's branch. {why} says why.

worktrees.merge.sameBranch.defaultMessage: The project folder has {branch} checked out.
worktrees.merge.sameBranch.description: Why nothing was merged: the project folder is on the worktree's own branch {branch}.

worktrees.merge.staged.defaultMessage: The project folder has staged changes. Commit or unstage them before merging.
worktrees.merge.staged.description: Why nothing was merged: changes are staged (git add) in the project folder.

worktrees.merge.unknownFiles.description: The list of a merge's conflicting files, when git didn't name them.

worktrees.missing.noAgent.description: An error: the agent whose missing worktree was to be recreated or unlinked was removed meanwhile.

worktrees.missing.noBranch.defaultMessage: {agent}'s branch {branch} is gone, and the project folder isn't on a branch to start a new one from.
worktrees.missing.noBranch.description: An error: the missing worktree of the agent {agent} (its name) can't be recreated: its branch {branch} is gone too, and there's no branch to make a new one from.

worktrees.missing.noTree.description: An error: the agent {agent} (its name) works in the project folder, so it has no worktree to recreate or unlink.

worktrees.missing.stillListed.defaultMessage: git still lists {folder} as a worktree (it may be locked): unlock it, or run git worktree prune, then try again.
worktrees.missing.stillListed.description: An error: git still has the missing worktree {folder} on its list, so it can't be recreated there. git worktree prune is a git command: keep it.

worktrees.missing.stopFirst.description: An error: the agent {agent} (its name) is running; its missing worktree can't be recreated until it stops.

worktrees.missing.thereRecreate.defaultMessage: {agent}'s worktree folder is there ({folder}): there's nothing to recreate.
worktrees.missing.thereRecreate.description: An error: the worktree folder {folder} of the agent {agent} (its name) exists, so it isn't missing.

worktrees.missing.thereUnlink.defaultMessage: {agent}'s worktree folder is there ({folder}): remove the agent to remove its worktree.
worktrees.missing.thereUnlink.description: An error: the worktree folder {folder} of the agent {agent} (its name) exists, so its link can't be dropped as a missing one.

worktrees.missing.wouldPrune.defaultMessage: Recreating runs git worktree prune, which would also drop git's link to {folders} (missing too). Locate, recreate or remove {n, plural, one {that worktree} other {those worktrees}} first.
worktrees.missing.wouldPrune.description: An error: recreating a missing worktree runs git worktree prune (a git command: keep it), which would also forget the other missing worktrees {folders} (a list of folders); {n} is how many.

worktrees.move.missing.description: Why the agent's branch wasn't moved after a squash merge: its worktree folder {folder} is gone.

worktrees.move.notEverything.description: Why the agent's branch {branch} wasn't moved after a squash merge: the branch merged into ({into}) lacks some of its changes.

worktrees.move.notOnBranch.description: Why the agent's branch wasn't moved after a squash merge: its worktree has another branch than {branch} checked out.

worktrees.names.closed.defaultMessage: The workspace was closed or switched: nothing was changed.
worktrees.names.closed.description: An error: the workspace closed, or another opened in its window, while a project's name was being recorded; nothing changed.

worktrees.names.projectGone.defaultMessage: That project is no longer in the workspace.
worktrees.names.projectGone.description: An error: the project whose name was being recorded was removed from the workspace meanwhile.

worktrees.readBranch.defaultMessage: git couldn't read the branch checked out in {folder} ({why})
worktrees.readBranch.description: An error: git couldn't say which branch the folder {folder} has checked out; {why} is git's reason.

worktrees.readOriginHead.description: An error: git couldn't read which branch is the remote's main branch (origin/HEAD, git's name: keep it); {why} is git's reason.

worktrees.reuse.beingRemoved.defaultMessage: it is being removed or merged
worktrees.reuse.beingRemoved.description: Why an unused worktree isn't reused for a new agent: it is being removed or merged right now. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.reuse.cantCheck.description: Why an unused worktree isn't reused for a new agent: git couldn't check whether it is merged into the branch {base}. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.reuse.gitBusy.description: Why an unused worktree isn't reused for a new agent: git is working in it (a lock file). A clause, lower case.

worktrees.reuse.inUse.description: Why an unused worktree isn't reused for a new agent: a program has it open (Windows won't let it be moved). A clause, lower case.

worktrees.reuse.movedAside.defaultMessage: Hive moved {folder} aside to check it and couldn't move it back: it is at {aside}.
worktrees.reuse.movedAside.description: An error: to check nothing used an unused worktree, Hive renamed its folder {folder} and couldn't rename it back; it is now at {aside}.

worktrees.reuse.notChecked.description: Why an unused worktree isn't reused for a new agent: it wasn't checked. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.reuse.notMerged.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} not merged into {base}
worktrees.reuse.notMerged.description: Why an unused worktree isn't reused for a new agent: commits on its branch that the branch {base} doesn't have. A clause, lower case; it may be joined with the uncommitted files in a list.

worktrees.reuse.resetFailed.defaultMessage: git couldn't bring it up to {base} ({why})
worktrees.reuse.resetFailed.description: Why an unused worktree isn't reused for a new agent: git couldn't move it to the branch {base}; {why} is git's message. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.reuse.taken.description: Why an unused worktree isn't reused for a new agent: another agent being added is taking it. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.reuse.uncommitted.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# uncommitted file} other {# uncommitted files}}
worktrees.reuse.uncommitted.description: Why an unused worktree isn't reused for a new agent: files changed in it and not committed. A clause, lower case; it may be joined with the unmerged commits in a list.

worktrees.reuse.unreadable.description: Why an unused worktree isn't reused for a new agent: git couldn't read where its locks are. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.statusFailed.defaultMessage: git status failed in its folder
worktrees.statusFailed.description: Why git couldn't check a worktree (after "Git couldn't check <branch>:"): git status failed in the worktree's folder. Lower case.

worktrees.unknownError.description: Why git couldn't do something, when nothing at all was said. Lower case: it follows a colon.

worktrees.why.cantCheck.description: Why Hive keeps a worktree: git couldn't check its branch {branch} for unmerged commits or uncommitted files. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.why.changed.description: Why Hive kept a worktree or its branch: the branch {branch} moved after Hive checked it was merged. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.why.folderMissing.description: Why Hive doesn't remove a worktree: its folder is gone. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.why.gitKept.description: Why a worktree or a branch wasn't removed: git refused. {why} is git's message, or the git command that failed. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.why.mainMoved.defaultMessage: {gone, select, yes {the main branch is gone, not {expected} as checked} other {the main branch is {now}, not {expected} as checked}}
worktrees.why.mainMoved.description: Why Hive kept a worktree: the repository's main branch is another one ({now}) than the one checked ({expected}), or it is gone (gone: yes). A clause, lower case.

worktrees.why.noMain.defaultMessage: the repository has no main branch (main or master) to check it against
worktrees.why.noMain.description: Why Hive keeps a worktree (it can't tell it is merged): the repository has no main branch. main and master are branch names: keep them. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.why.notChecked.description: Why Hive kept a worktree: it wasn't checked for unmerged or uncommitted work. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.why.notListed.defaultMessage: git doesn't list it as a worktree on {branch}
worktrees.why.notListed.description: Why Hive keeps a worktree: git doesn't list it as one of the project's worktrees on its branch {branch}. A clause, lower case.

worktrees.why.notMerged.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} not merged into {into}
worktrees.why.notMerged.description: Why Hive keeps a worktree: commits on its branch that the branch {into} doesn't have. A clause, lower case; it may be joined with the uncommitted files in a list.

worktrees.why.uncommitted.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# uncommitted file} other {# uncommitted files}}
worktrees.why.uncommitted.description: Why Hive keeps a worktree: files changed in it and not committed. A clause, lower case; it may be joined with the unmerged commits in a list.
